mentions.name: Session Recorder Chrome Extension
mentions.description: A free, open source Chrome extension that records browser usage sessions entirely locally. It captures clicks, typing, page changes, network requests and responses, console errors, screenshots, and video with sound, and can optionally record voice narration that is transcribed and placed next to the corresponding activity. Users can add annotations like arrows and boxes drawn on page screenshots. Passwords, auth headers, and tokens are masked at capture time, and all events are lined up in a timestamped timeline. Sessions live in IndexedDB with no account, backend, or telemetry, and export as a zip; at export users pick a detail level with a live token estimate so a long session fits a model's context window.
mentions.problem: Existing session-recording tools upload captured session details to their cloud and try to monetize them; this project provides a free, open source, fully local alternative.
mentions.source_excerpt: This is a Chrome extension that records lots of details in a usage session. Stuff like network calls, console logs, screenshots and also optionally screenshots and user narration
